identity.title: First detection of methanol towards a post-AGB object, HD 101584

paper_type_evidence.quote: in the course of a chemical study of an interesting post-AGB object HD 101584 using ALMA, we have detected methanol for the first time in an AGB-related object

evidence.quote: The distance is estimated to be 0.7 kpc, but recent Gaia data suggests a somewhat larger distance, 0.9 – 1.8 kpc.

question.value: Is methanol present in the post-AGB object HD 101584, where does it originate, and do isotope ratios support its post-AGB nature?

evidence.quote: Here we provide further evidence, based on circumstellar isotopolog ratios, for the post-AGB nature of HD 101584.
in two frequency settings in Band 6, one for the $^{12}$CO($J$ = 2–1) line and one for the $^{13}$CO($J$ = 2–1) line (only Cycle 1)

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: four 1.875 GHz spectral windows with 3840 channels each

evidence.quote: the data set contains four 1.875 GHz spectral windows with 3840 channels each
the $J_K$ = 4$_2$–3$_1$ line at 218.440 GHz and the 8$_{-1}$–7$_0$ line at 229.759 GHz
the $J_K$ = 4$_2$–3$_1$ line at 218.440 GHz and the 8$_{-1}$–7$_0$ line at 229.759 GHz

arrays.value: 12 m main array, 35 to 43 antennas, Cycles 1 and 3

evidence.quote: during Cycles 1 and 3 with 35 to 43 antennas of the 12 m main array
data obtained in three different configurations were combined
The baselines range from 13 to 12934 m.

provided.value: 12CO 3-2 and 4-3, C17O and C18O 2-1 line data

evidence.quote: Complementary $^{12}$CO $J$ = 3–2 and 4–3, and C$^{17}$O and C$^{18}$O $J$ = 2–1 line data were obtained using APEX.
we make use of the $^{12}$CO and $^{13}$CO $J$ = 1–0 data published by (cite: olofnyma99)
Collisional coefficients for CH$_3$OH were taken from (cite: pottetal04).

pipeline_or_manual.value: CASA reduction with Tsys, WVR, bandpass and gain calibration

evidence.quote: bandpass and gain calibration were done
The data were reduced using CASA 4.5.2.
Flux calibration was done using Ceres and Titan.
we estimate the absolute flux calibration to be accurate to within 5%

self_calibration.value: on the strong continuum, per tuning

evidence.quote: for each individual tuning, self-calibration was performed on the strong continuum
Imaging was done using the CASA clean algorithm
The final line images were created using natural weighting.

continuum_subtraction.value: performed on the line data before imaging

evidence.quote: after a continuum subtraction was performed on the emission line data

what.value: Very little flux lost in 12CO(2-1) data

evidence.quote: concluded that very little flux is lost even in the $^{12}$CO(2–1) ALMA data

unstated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum subtraction order
Clean threshold, mask, cell and image size
Final beam and rms per line
Radiative transfer code name and version
Region used for extreme-velocity spot fluxes
Which CASA step and ALMA products correspond to each project code

method.value: Gaussian line decomposition of APEX data and ALMA central 0.5'' emission to get integrated intensity ratios

evidence.quote: We have determined the intensities of the emission coming from the very central region, within 0.5$''$ of HD 101584 in the ALMA data
The values within parentheses give the uncertainties in the Gaussian fits used to determine the line parameters.

analysis_steps.goal: Radiative transfer abundances of extreme velocity spot

method.value: Accelerated-Lambda-Iteration code with two-zone spherical clump model, fitted to 4'' E EVS line intensities

evidence.quote: we solve the radiative transfer using an Accelerated-Lambda-Iteration code, taking into account excitation through collisions with H$_2$

key_parameters.value: Inner n=5e6 cm-3, T=200 K, R=0.15''; outer n=5e5 cm-3, T=60 K, R=1''

assumptions.value: Spherical clump; torsionally excited CH3OH states not included (abundance may be underestimated by up to factor of two)

evidence.quote: We have not included the torsionally excited states of methanol, which may lead to an underestimate of its abundance by up to a factor of two.
The size of the higher-density region is constrained by requiring that the $^{28}$SiO/$^{29}$SiO abundance ratio equals 20 (the solar value)
The data were reduced using CASA 4.5.2.
The integrated line intensity ratio is 13$\pm$6
The estimated gas mass of the 4$''$ E EVS is 4$\times$10$^{-3}$ M$_\odot$.
CH$_3$OH has an estimated abundance of 3$\times$10$^{-6}$ (assuming an $E$-to-$A$ ratio of 1)

findings_qualitative.value: CH3OH emission comes exclusively from the extreme velocity spots

evidence.quote: the CH$_3$OH line emission comes exclusively from the EVSs

claims.hypothesis: Is methanol present in an AGB-related object?
claims.result: CH3OH 4_2-3_1 and 8_-1-7_0 detected in the EVSs
claims.finding: First detection of methanol in an AGB-related object

evidence.quote: We have, for the first time, detected CH$_3$OH towards an AGB-related object, HD 101584.

claims.hypothesis: HD 101584 is a post-AGB low-mass M-type star
claims.experiment: CO isotopologue intensity ratios from APEX and ALMA
claims.finding: Remnant of a solar-mass M-type AGB star

evidence.quote: we have added evidence that HD 101584 is a post-AGB object, the remnant of a solar-mass M-type AGB star.

claims.experiment: Comparison of abundances with YSO outflows
claims.finding: Post-shock chemistry involving circumstellar grains proposed; details unclear

evidence.quote: we propose that the detected molecular species in the EVSs have their origin in a post-shock chemistry where circumstellar grains play a role

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Evaporation of planetary system objects rejected because CH3OH/H2CO ratio differs from comets

evidence.quote: the observed CH$_3$OH/H$_2$CO abundance ratio is very different, for example, $\approx$ 10 in comets

limitations_admitted.value: Geometry uncertain; simple model gives only order-of-magnitude abundances

evidence.quote: In order to get at least order-of-magnitude estimates we assume a spherical clump

referee_caveats_inferred: Single-clump model with unconstrained geometry; no uncertainties on abundances
Distance uncertain (0.7 vs 0.9-1.8 kpc) affects physical scales
Methanol detection in two lines only, no rotation diagram

reproducibility.score_reason: Data are archival-linked and calibration is described, but imaging and modelling details are sparse.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Imaging recipe and radiative transfer code are not specified enough.
